motion.name: arrow-feedback

motion.name: anchor-scroll

motion.name: skill-highlight
motion.purpose: Per-instance LayoutGroup and AnimatePresence share a soft-blue background across hovered or focused cards; content stays stationary. Reduced motion omits layoutId and sets duration to zero. The explicit duration governs opacity; no custom layout easing is declared.

motion.name: timeline-progress
motion.value: scaleY: scrollYProgress; transform-origin: top; offsets: start 75%, end 55%
motion.purpose: Transform-only blue beam in the semantic academic timeline; reduced motion sets scaleY to 1 for a full static beam.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: CSS elements and pseudo-elements in prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Arrow hover transforms remain instantaneous. Framer Motion separately disables shared skill layout/duration and makes the timeline beam static.

narrative.overview:
White, graphite lettering and quiet gray surfaces frame real engineering work. Large, left-aligned Manrope headings and Geist copy keep the portfolio precise, open and restrained. The owner selected light neutrals with restrained blue accents and no large color blocks.

Project imagery supplies evidence; the interface supplies alignment, fine separators and direct routes to source, resume and contact. Skills receive prominent typography inside neutral linked cards with a shared soft-blue highlight. Teaching and education use the same restrained accent in an academic timeline. These owner-requested Aceternity adaptations extend the incumbent system. This records the implemented system; route strategy remains in `.impeccable/surface-home.md`.
keyCharacteristics: White and graphite with restrained blue actions and focus.
Open layouts with fine dividers and modest image corners.
Prominent wrapping skills in neutral linked cards and compact, equally treated project previews.
Visible content with directional link feedback, a shared skill highlight and a restrained scroll-progress timeline; static effects under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep broad regions white or neutral gray; use blue for actions, focus and small identity details.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Manrope carries headings and the wordmark; Geist carries prose, navigation, actions and technical metadata.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Frame project evidence with neutral mats, spacing and fine rules; keep entries flat at rest and on hover.

dos: Do keep broad regions white or neutral gray with restrained blue actions and focus.
Do pair Manrope headings with locally hosted Geist prose and metadata.
Do contain real project imagery inside modestly rounded neutral mats.
Do retain prominent wrapping skill lists, visible keyboard focus and direct destinations.
donts: Don't add large colored fields or a dominant featured project to the revised portfolio.
Don't replace project evidence with invented imagery or claims.
Don't turn technology metadata into interactive pills without a real interaction.
Don't promote unused compatibility tokens or preview-only tonal ramps into shipped variants.
